newsitem.title: UK: STG FIRMS FROM LAST WEEK'S LOWS IN QUIET EUROPE.
newsitem.headline: STG FIRMS FROM LAST WEEK'S LOWS IN QUIET EUROPE.

text.p: Sterling clawed back some territory lost in Friday's tumble, firming against the German mark and steady against the dollar by the European midsession on Monday, but traders said nervousness remained ahead of key UK data due later this week.
"There was something of an over-reaction last week in a thin market," Stewart Newnham, International Economist at First Chicago, said. "The pound is fundamentally still quite strong."
Sterling/mark gained almost three pfennigs from its early session lows, trading at 2.9545/55 marks by midday Europe. It stood at 2.9272/77 in Europe late Friday.
